core_obligations: Reduce to a complete local ring (proof lines 3957-3978): the completion of the ring is again normal and has a resolution, sequences of normalized blowups of the completion come from sequences over the ring, and regularity transfers along the completion, so it suffices to treat the complete case; then the ring is Nagata and excellent with a dualizing complex, and the same holds for rings essentially of finite type over it.

Dominate the resolution by normalized blowups (proof lines 3980-4004): choose a sequence of normalized blowups dominating the given resolution; the dominating morphism is an isomorphism away from finitely many points, so a further sequence of blowups in closed points dominates the last term of the sequence; hence that normal surface has a resolution, which by the isomorphism criterion for modifications of normal surfaces means it has only finitely many singular points.

Transfer rational singularities and pass to Gorenstein rings (proof lines 4006-4028): each singular point lies over a regular point of the original surface, which defines a rational singularity, and the rational singularity property propagates along the local map, so the singularities of the dominating surface are rational; for each of them finitely many blowups in singular closed points produce Gorenstein local rings, and these combine into a single sequence of blowups.

Finish by resolving rational double points (proof lines 4030-4044): the resulting surface is normal with Gorenstein local rings, and one dominates it again by a sequence of blowups in points, so it has only finitely many singularities, this time rational double points; resolving those completes the argument, giving a resolution by normalized blowups.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the complete case using the transfer of normality and regularity along completion and the descent of sequences of normalized blowups.
Dominate the given resolution by normalized blowups, then by blowups in closed points, to see that the dominating surface has only finitely many singularities.
Propagate rationality from the regular points below, make the local rings Gorenstein by finitely many blowups, and finish by resolving the resulting rational double points.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that if the spectrum of a normal two dimensional Noetherian local ring has a resolution of singularities then it has a resolution by normalized blowups (statement lines 3949-3955). The proof (proof lines 3957-4048) reduces to the complete case via the behaviour of normality and regularity under completion, dominates the given resolution by normalized blowups and then by point blowups, propagates rationality of the singularities from the regular points below, passes to Gorenstein local rings by finitely many blowups, and finishes by resolving the resulting rational double points. H3: a multi-stage reduction combining several chapter results with genuine transfers of properties, written out in full.
